info.title: awesome-mcp REST Data Plane
info.description: Combined catalog of REST passthrough endpoints across every service wired into this awesome-mcp instance. Use the mintRestBearerForCurl MCP tool to mint a 5-minute bearer token, then GET these URLs to fetch bulk responses directly to disk without burning LLM context.

get.description: Thin wrapper over ClickUp's server-side Get Filtered Team Tasks endpoint (GET /api/v2/team/{team_id}/task). One paginated call replaces per-list enumeration for workspace-wide digests. Supports assignees, statuses, tags, scope narrowing (spaceIds/projectIds/listIds), and date ranges on date_created / date_updated / due_date. Does NOT support date_closed / date_done filters — for 'closed since T', query with dateUpdatedGt=T and partition on date_closed client-side.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace (team) ID

parameters.name: assignees
parameters.description: Filter to tasks assigned to any of these user IDs. Repeat the param for multiple values.

parameters.name: statuses
parameters.description: Filter by status names. Repeat the param for multiple values.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Filter by tag names. Repeat the param for multiple values.

parameters.name: spaceIds
parameters.description: Narrow to specific space IDs. Repeat the param for multiple values.

parameters.name: projectIds
parameters.description: Narrow to specific folder (project) IDs. Repeat the param for multiple values.

parameters.name: listIds
parameters.description: Narrow to specific list IDs. Repeat the param for multiple values.

parameters.name: dateCreatedGt
parameters.description: Only tasks created at/after this time. ISO string or Unix ms.

parameters.name: dateCreatedLt
parameters.description: Only tasks created at/before this time. ISO string or Unix ms.

parameters.name: dateUpdatedGt
parameters.description: Only tasks updated at/after this time. ISO string or Unix ms. Use as a superset for 'closed since T' queries.

parameters.name: dateUpdatedLt
parameters.description: Only tasks updated at/before this time. ISO string or Unix ms.

parameters.name: dueDateGt
parameters.description: Only tasks with due_date at/after this time. ISO string or Unix ms.

parameters.name: dueDateLt
parameters.description: Only tasks with due_date at/before this time. ISO string or Unix ms.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Sort field. No server-side close-date sort.

parameters.name: reverse
parameters.description: Reverse the sort order.

parameters.name: subtasks
parameters.description: Include subtasks in results.

parameters.name: includeClosed
parameters.description: Include closed/completed tasks.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (0-based). 100 tasks per page.

parameters.name: custom_fields
parameters.description: JSON-encoded custom field filters.

200.description: Filtered tasks retrieved successfully

get.summary: Read task-event transitions from the webhook store
get.description: Reads events populated by the ClickUp webhook receiver: status transitions, moves, assignee changes, task creations and deletions. Scoped to the caller's own subscription for the workspace. If no subscription exists, returns 200 with kind='no-subscription' + a warning — not 404 — so digests can gracefully fall back to filterTeamTasks with dateUpdatedGt.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace (team) ID

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only return events at/after this time. ISO string or Unix ms.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Only return events at/before this time. ISO string or Unix ms.

parameters.name: eventTypes
parameters.description: Filter to specific event types. Repeat the param for multiple values.

parameters.name: toStatus
parameters.description: Only return status-transition events whose destination status equals this label.

parameters.name: taskId
parameters.description: Narrow to a single task.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Row cap. Narrow via since if you hit it.

200.description: Task events retrieved (kind='ok') or subscription missing (kind='no-subscription')

get.summary: List task-event webhook subscriptions owned by the caller
get.description: Surfaces subscription health so operators can spot a dying webhook (ClickUp stops delivering after 5 consecutive failures). shared_secret is never returned.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Optional workspace ID to narrow to a single subscription.

200.description: Subscription list

get.description: Cross-references the local subscription record against ClickUp's own view of the webhook and the event store. Detects endpoint-URL drift (BASE_URL changed between subscribe and now), orphaned ClickUp webhook (local record points at a webhook ClickUp deleted), event-bundle mismatch, ClickUp fail_count exceeding our stored fail_count (ingestion route silently 200-ing on thrown errors), disabled-webhook status, and the 'zero events with zero delivery failures' pattern that means deliveries either are not reaching the ingestion route or are being silently swallowed. Returns 200 even for broken states.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace (team) ID

200.description: Diagnostic report

get.description: Lists one page of docs in a workspace, in ClickUp's own order (oldest first). Returns nextCursor when more pages exist. To find a doc by name across the whole workspace, use the /docs/search sibling.

get.description: Finds docs by name across the entire workspace, newest first, paging through all docs internally. Matching is case-insensitive and token-based: every word in the query must appear in the title, in any order. The response carries totalScanned, pagesScanned, hitCap and rateLimited so an empty result can be told apart from an incomplete scan.

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace ID

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Words to match against doc names (case-insensitive, order-independent, all must appear). Omit to list all docs newest-first.

parameters.name: creator
parameters.description: Filter by creator user ID

parameters.name: parentId
parameters.description: Filter by parent ID. Required with parentType SPACE, FOLDER, or LIST.

parameters.name: parentType
parameters.description: Restrict to docs in this container kind. EVERYTHING means no restriction.

200.description: Search results retrieved successfully

post.summary: Re-host an image and get a public URL
post.description: Re-hosts an image on this server (recompressed to WebP) and returns a public URL you can embed in a ClickUp Doc as markdown. Send EITHER raw image bytes as the body (Content-Type image/png, image/jpeg, image/gif, image/bmp, or image/webp) OR application/json with an imageUrl to fetch and re-host. Requires a connected ClickUp account.

imageUrl.description: Public http(s) URL of an image to fetch and re-host (jpg, png, gif, bmp, or webp).

url.description: Public URL to embed as image markdown.

deduped.description: True if identical bytes were already stored.

400.description: Missing/invalid body, or the imageUrl could not be fetched

413.description: Recompressed image exceeds the storage size cap
